_comment: Numbers from the Step 0 measurement of 2026-09-30 on a 16 GB card with the pinned build (1024x1024, 20 steps, Q4_K_M diffusion + Q4_K_M encoder + bf16 VAE): peak VRAM 9.1 GB with --offload-to-cpu (10.0 GB without), dominated by the 7.8 GB VAE decode buffer, so a 12 GB card is the floor and the free requirement is the diffusion file plus 5 GB; peak RAM 9.9 GB with the offload, 0.8 GB without; engine time about 60 s either way. Every width and height is a multiple of 32 (sd.cpp requirement). No model names, URLs or download links belong here.
